Name: Instant Sprinkler
Author: xixifu
Description:
[b]原版的洒水器很奇怪。[/b] 尽管它们是由你亲手建造，但在清晨到来之前，你却无法控制它们。是时候掌握主动权了！安装此 Mod，让洒水器真正成为你农场中[b]可靠且即时的好帮手[/b]吧！
[list]
[*][b]掌控全局：[/b] 按下右键即可立即激活洒水器，瞬间浇水，即时解决布局错误或补救缺水的作物。
[*][b]完美兼容：[/b] 支持所有原版洒水器（包括铱制），并能自动识别[b]加压喷头[/b]并扩大范围。
[*][b]平衡与体验：[/b] 通过配置可开启[b]体力消耗[/b]和[b]每日一次[/b]限制，同时具备流畅的即时动画反馈。
[/list][b]The sprinklers are strange.[/b] While [i]you[/i] built them, you have no direct control—they simply wait until morning. It’s time to take control! Install this mod and turn your sprinklers into the [b]instant, reliable farm helpers[/b] they were meant to be.
[list]
[*][b]Take Control:[/b] Right-click to trigger any sprinkler and water tiles [i]immediately[/i], solving layout issues or saving thirsty crops on the spot.
[*][b]Comprehensive Support:[/b] Works with all vanilla tiers (including Iridium) and automatically adapts to [b]Pressure Nozzles[/b].
[*][b]Balance & QoL:[/b] Features configurable [b]Stamina Costs[/b] and a [b]Once-Per-Day[/b] limit for fair gameplay, complete with satisfying instant animations.
[/list]

Manifest.Name: Instant Sprinkler
Manifest.Description: Allows you to manually trigger sprinklers by clicking on them, instantly watering nearby crops without waiting for the next day.
Manifest.Author: Xavier Nico
